reasoning: Louisiana v. Callais presents a direct challenge to race-conscious districting under Section 2 of the VRA. The current Court has shown willingness to narrow VRA provisions (Shelby County, Brnovich), though Allen v. Milligan (2023) surprisingly upheld Section 2's application to redistricting. However, oral arguments reportedly suggest the Court may be ready to curtail Section 2. The 6-3 conservative majority creates real possibility of a sweeping ruling. Still, the Court often rules narrowly, and completely invalidating race-conscious districting would be a dramatic step even for this Court. I estimate moderate-to-substantial probability of a broad ruling.
